verdicts.evidence: At aad865 ALLOWED_PUNCTUATION had only ASCII ' and -. The author said they fixed it ("Fixed 1, 4, 5 and 7"), and commit 87ca89ad2 added SMART_PUNCTUATION folding (’→', –/—/−→-) in name.schema.ts:11-15.
In the name.schema.ts:46 thread, vmosharova said allowing an empty string when minLength is 0 is intended, for future optional name fields. HEAD keeps this: the `if (min > 0)` guard in superRefine.

The bot called this a footnote that isn't actionable yet, and nobody responded. name.builder.ts still slices by code point with `[...padded].slice(0, NAME_MAX_LENGTH)`; 2fe513f only added sanitizeName before it.
The author's replies list the fixed items and don't include this one, and nobody else reacted. ALLOWED_NAME_REGEX still uses `\p{N}` at HEAD (name.schema.ts:21-24).

At aad865 an input that was empty after stripping failed on the min-length refine. The author listed item 7 as fixed, and 87ca89ad2 added EMPTY_NAME_MESSAGE, which is checked first.

At aad865 csv-export.options.ts escaped only through cast.string. The author said "Fixed 1 and 2 in 1fd2688" (rebased as 2fe513f), which adds castCell for the string, number, boolean and bigint casts.
